method: Each URL below was fetched once with a page-fetch tool on 2026-11-02 and the returned title and body were read. A field is filled only when the exact wording appears on that official page; otherwise it is left blank and recorded in notStated. No value is inferred, converted, summed or rounded. amountUsd is the literal figure the page states for the headline prize/pool, parsed for sorting only. Three further official pages were read while integrating the independent rules review handed off by session 4db3cf09-own1 in PR #3 (Metaculus Tournament Rules, the GEMS Prize official rules PDF and the DrivenData GEMS rules page).
